name: RC-B10-0357/2026 – After § 5 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text: 5a. Denounces the fact that networks based in or operating through the UAE have facilitated the supply of weapons, dual-use items, financing, logistics and the laundering of conflict-gold for the RSF; urges the Council and the EEAS to address RSF financing and procurement linked to the UAE and to propose restrictive measures against entities and individuals enabling RSF abuses; calls for strengthened due diligence and traceability requirements for Sudanese gold and raw materials entering the EU;
